sections.brief: Exit as built: Seasteading Institute (Thiel $500k seed; $1.25M/2011 vs $1.7M/2018), Tahiti MoU 13 Jan 2017 lapsed end-2017 (RNZ); Romer 2009, Honduras RED 124-1 (Jan 2011), struck down 18 Oct 2012, Romer resigns; ZEDE law 12 Jun 2013 102-26; Pronomos (Aug 2019, Thiel anchor >half of ~$9M; Andreessen, Ver, Srinivasan; >=$13.3M 2023); Praxis ($525M drawdown facility; Greenland posts; Thiel denial; Uruguay +Colonia non-binding MoU); Network School (Forest City 2024, Johor notice 17 Jul 2026, Kazakhstan MoU); funding typed and graded by degree. Figures: money, time

Próspera: charter (23 Aug 2018; 9-member council, company's 4 trustees block two-thirds measures; e-residents no vote; referendum only >10,000; CAMP; arbitration); investors (>$120M; Pronomos one step from Thiel; Coinbase Ventures 21 Jan 2025); Crawfish Rock (2020 confrontation and denial; Connor, Cárdenas; 49-resident resolution); repeal 21 Apr 2022; Supreme Court 20 Sep 2024 ex tunc; US pressure (Gosar, Horsford, House report) and 32-member letter; ICSID ARB/23/2 timeline, $10.775bn -> restitution or $1.63bn, PO6 19 Mar 2026; ICSID exit and rejoin 16 Aug 2026; status Oct 2026 pending. Figures: flow, time, compare

Argentina: Milei anarcho-capitalist (link de9); no charter-city/ZEDE policy documented; citizenship-by-investment Decree 524/2025 not live; Milei's Aug 2023 visit to +Colonia, Bastitta ex-adviser, Praxis MoU (developer tie, not state). Freedom Cities: Agenda47 3 Mar 2023; Coalition (NeWay/Próspera, Goff meetings); Bell's draft act; AEI Homesteading 2.0; Dans; Lee land-sale provision withdrawn 28 Jun 2025; PolitiFact 'Stalled' 10 Feb 2026; no law by late Jul 2026; Property Clause/FLPMA limits; ORANGE; worst-case reading tested for the part (enclave documented, capture route not supported). Figures: compare
